script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       j.command,
       j.job_status,
       j.lease_owner,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.row_version,
       j.attempt_count,
       j.idempotency_key,
       j.correlation_id,
       j.request_payload,
       j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_RPguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT x.item, x.b, x.bin, x.hu,
       CAST(IFNULL(SUM(x.total_price), 0) AS CHAR) AS tp,
       CAST(IFNULL(SUM(x.bq), 0) AS CHAR) AS bq
FROM (
  SELECT CAST(o.item_id AS CHAR) AS item,
         IFNULL(NULLIF(CAST(o.batch_number_id AS CHAR), ''), '0') AS b,
         IFNULL(CAST(o.bin_location_id AS CHAR), '') AS bin,
         IFNULL(NULLIF(CAST(o.handling_unit_id AS CHAR), ''), '0') AS hu,
         o.id, o.transaction_type, o.movement, o.inventory_category, o.total_price,
         COALESCE(o.base_qty, o.quantity) AS bq,
         MAX(CASE WHEN o.transaction_type = 'GDL-R' THEN o.id END) OVER () AS last_r
  FROM inventory_movement o
  WHERE o.id >= {{node:code_node_RPentry.data.gdId}} - 15099494400000
    AND o.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.organizationId}}'
    AND o.trx_no = (SELECT g.delivery_no FROM goods_delivery g WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_RPentry.data.gdId}})
    AND o.transaction_type IN ('GDL', 'GDL-R')
    AND o.is_deleted = 0
) x
WHERE x.transaction_type = 'GDL'
  AND x.movement = 'OUT'
  AND x.inventory_category = 'Reserved'
  AND x.id > IFNULL(x.last_r, 0)
GROUP BY x.item, x.b, x.bin, x.hu

script.code:
SELECT CAST(o.item_id AS CHAR) AS item,
       IFNULL(NULLIF(CAST(o.batch_number_id AS CHAR), ''), '0') AS b,
       IFNULL(CAST(o.bin_location_id AS CHAR), '') AS bin,
       IFNULL(NULLIF(CAST(o.handling_unit_id AS CHAR), ''), '0') AS hu,
       CAST(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(o.movement) = 'OUT' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * COALESCE(o.base_qty, o.quantity)), 0) AS CHAR) AS net_bq,
       CAST(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(o.movement) = 'OUT' AND o.inventory_category = 'Unrestricted' THEN o.total_price END), 0) AS CHAR) AS u_tp,
       CAST(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(o.movement) = 'OUT' AND o.inventory_category = 'Unrestricted' THEN COALESCE(o.base_qty, o.quantity) END), 0) AS CHAR) AS u_bq,
       MAX(o.parent_trx_no) AS parent_no
FROM inventory_movement o
WHERE o.id > (SELECT MAX(s.id) FROM gd_completion_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND s.gd_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.gdId}}' AND s.snapshot_status = 'Active' AND s.is_deleted = 0)
  AND o.id < (SELECT MAX(s.id) FROM gd_completion_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND s.gd_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.gdId}}' AND s.snapshot_status = 'Active' AND s.is_deleted = 0) + 362387865600000
  AND o.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.organizationId}}'
  AND o.trx_no = (SELECT g.delivery_no FROM goods_delivery g WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_RPentry.data.gdId}})
  AND o.transaction_type = 'GDL'
  AND o.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
